headline: They waited almost 19 years. A historic moment on the Polish stock exchange
summary: The WIG20 index moved above its October 2007 peak at Monday's opening. The broad WIG index and the mid-cap index also set new records as prices on the Polish stock exchange rose.
why: WIG20 tracks the 20 largest companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange, so it is the main gauge of Polish large-cap equities.
why_moved: Prices on the Warsaw Stock Exchange rose, pushing the WIG20, WIG and mid-cap indexes to record levels at the Monday open.
